description: This is a test configuration script using pytest fixtures for testing a FastAPI application. It sets environment variables required for testing, imports the FastAPI app, and creates test clients and authorization headers for integration tests of the Notes Backend API.

methods.name: None _set_required_env()
methods.description: Sets default environment variables required for testing the application, only if they are not already set.

methods.name: Any app()
methods.description: Imports and returns the FastAPI app instance from src.api.main.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[AsyncClient] client(app: Any)
methods.description: Creates and provides an asynchronous HTTPX client wired to the FastAPI app for testing.

methods.name: str _signup_and_get_token(ac: AsyncClient, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Automates signup of a user and retrieves the authentication token.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] auth_headers(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Creates a user and provides the authorization headers for authenticated requests.

ctags.name: _signup_and_get_token
ctags.pattern: /^async def _signup_and_get_token(ac: AsyncClient, *, email: str, password: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: fastapi_app
ctags.pattern: /^    from src.api.main import app as fastapi_app  # noqa: WPS433 (allow import inside function)$/
